dream_outcome.statement: One critical AI use case. Twelve weeks. A production decision that leadership, IT and compliance can all defend.

time_delay.full_outcome: 12 weeks to the go / limited-go / no-go decision package and handover.
time_delay.first_verified_value: Weeks 1-2 produce the mandate, baseline, risk map, ownership and acceptance criteria.

client_inputs: A named sponsor able to arbitrate scope across the engagement.
Access to the selected use case systems, logs, data or documents under NDA.
Two internal people available for the transfer phase.

controlled_commitments: Validated architecture and identified-risk register within the agreed scope.
Automated quality gates and regression criteria defined for the selected use case.
Governance layer, execution evidence and operational runbooks delivered for the selected use case.
excluded_outcomes: Regulatory compliance or certification is not guaranteed.
The production decision remains with the accountable client owner.
Company-wide AI transformation is outside the core engagement.
Ongoing operations and on-call after handover are outside the core engagement.
